about: The masters of Palermo Noir's wiki pictures (WebP, quality 90): one Recraft scene per entry, a wide picture (4096x2286) for heroes on landscape screens and for the cards, and a tall one (2286x4096) for portrait screens. tools/make-wiki-art.py makes the served sizes from them. George asked for them on 26 Oct 2026 ('Generate art for each wiki item. Same we did at exitwise.'), picked the four samples on the review page https://claude.ai/artifact/YNHdfu7s2QDSNvXM7cxSFv and approved the full set the same day. Each entry's prompt is the opening, its cast sentence, the town sentence, 'The scene: ' + its scene and the wide closing; the tall picture's prompt is the opening, the cast sentence, the recompose sentence and the tall closing, with the 1K wide as the last reference.
licence: Made on VGraphics' Recraft Pro account (a paid plan, plus purchased credit packs), so the images are VGraphics' to use commercially under Recraft's terms. Nano Banana 2 is Google's partner model in Recraft; its usage policy was accepted on 22 Oct 2026.
model: Nano Banana 2 in Recraft, 1K (1376x768 wide, 768x1376 tall), one take per picture, then Recraft Crisp upscale (4096x2286 and 2286x4096), 26 Oct 2026. No readable text in any picture: papers, cards and screens carry only lines, patterns and plain strokes.

references.cast: References 5 and on: the character's picked cast picture, VHub docs/party/design-pass/art/raw-cast-v2/cast-<key>.png (listed per entry)
references.town: Last reference of a wide picture: the current hero, the seafront (palermo/img/key-art-wide-1920.webp)
references.wide: Last reference of a tall picture: the entry's own 1K wide picture

prompt.opening: References 1 to 4 show the exact art style to copy: gold engraved line art on a flat dark navy background. Faces and skin are drawn with dense, fine, perfectly vertical parallel lines, with one side of each face falling into solid navy shadow along a sharp clean edge; hair and hats with flowing parallel contour lines; clothes outlined in thin warm-gold lines and filled with long vertical hatching. Only warm tan-gold lines (about #C9A98A, highlights #E0C2A5) on navy (#0C1725), {light}: no other colours, no grey, no paper texture.

light.night: with the warm glow of lamps, candles or a match as the only light
light.early morning: with the warm gold light of early morning as the only light, the sky still a deep navy

prompt.cast: One character: "Reference 5 is the game's character <cast description>: draw them exactly as they look there, the same face, clothes and props." Several: "References 5 to <n> are the game's characters: <descriptions>. Draw them exactly as they look there, the same faces, clothes and props." (The samples name the character the same way, in their own words.)
prompt.town: Reference <n> shows how the game draws its town at night: draw the buildings, lamps, stones and sky in that same engraved look.
prompt.closingWide: This is the wide hero picture of a page in the game's wiki: a 16:9 cinematic scene, every wall, stone and fold fully drawn in fine engraved hatching, with rich depth from the foreground to the background. Keep the faces and hands in the middle band of the picture, well clear of the top and bottom edges. Keep the bottom fifth calm and dark, fading into shadow, so words can sit there, and keep the top left corner quiet for the logo. Crime is implied, never shown: no blood, no bodies, no guns, no knives. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signs, no frame, no border.
prompt.recomposeTall: Reference <n> is the wide version of this same picture: recompose that exact scene as a tall 9:16 portrait picture, with the same place, the same people, clothes, props, light and details, rearranged to fill the tall frame: bring the main figures closer and larger in the upper middle, with the setting around and above them.
prompt.closingTall: This is the tall version of the same hero picture, for phone screens: a 9:16 portrait-format scene, every wall, stone and fold fully drawn in fine engraved hatching, with rich depth. Keep the faces and hands in the upper middle of the picture. Keep the bottom fifth calm and dark, fading into shadow, so words can sit there, and keep the top left corner quiet for the logo. Crime is implied, never shown: no blood, no bodies, no guns, no knives. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signs, no frame, no border.
prompt.corner: The full set's tall pictures and the three redone wides replace 'keep the top left corner quiet for the logo' with 'keep the top left corner darker and calm for the logo, but still fully drawn edge to edge: no blank boxes or empty patches anywhere' (the first Power of attorney came back with a blank box there).

known-killer.scene: a narrow back alley in old Palermo at night. In the right third of the picture the Known Killer stands in a stone doorway, half turned towards us, lighting a cigarette with a match cupped in his hands; the small flame lights his face from below and throws his long shadow up the wall behind him. The alley runs away to the left between tall old houses with wrought-iron balconies, closed wooden shutters and laundry lines, one street lamp glowing far down at its end, the wet cobblestones catching its light, and a black cat watching from a step.

doctor.scene: a small bedroom in an old Palermo house at night. In the left half of the picture the Doctor sits on a wooden chair at a bedside, leaning forward, listening with her stethoscope to a sleeping patient whose face is turned away under the blankets; her open leather doctor's bag stands on the floor by her feet. A small oil lamp on the bedside table casts a warm pool of light over her face and hands, the pillow and a glass of water. Behind them a tall window with half-open wooden shutters shows the moonlit rooftops and a church dome; the rest of the room falls into dark navy shadow.

the-night.scene: a quiet Palermo piazza at midnight under a full moon veiled by thin clouds; every window is dark and shuttered, the whole town asleep. On the left, in the shadow of a stone archway, the two killers lean together and whisper, choosing tonight's victim. In the middle a baroque stone fountain and one ornate street lamp glow warm gold over the empty cobbles. On the right the Doctor hurries along the wall with her bag towards a door, and above her, at an upper window, the Detective watches the square through a gap in the shutters, his pipe in his mouth. Small full-length figures, far apart, each in their own pool of light or shadow.

medals.about: The medals of the 8 rules pages (shown beside What it does), each its own picture so no two pages share one (George, 26 Oct: Each art must be used only once). Before, they were crops of the landing page's scenes, and five were the same picture. Masters in art-src/medals/<slug>.webp (1024, WebP q90); the served medal is img/medals/<slug>.webp (320, WebP q86). The role and power medals are crops of the role and power cards, as before (tools/make-wiki-composites.py).

medals.references: References 1-4: George's four portraits (as for the scenes); reference 5: the Alibi power card, VHub docs/party/design-pass/art/raw-powers/power-6-1.png, for the objects' look.
medals.prompt: "The four reference images show the exact art style to copy. Gold engraved line art on a flat dark navy background. Surfaces are drawn with dense, fine, perfectly vertical parallel lines, with one side of each object falling into solid navy shadow along a sharp clean edge, and clean contour lines in warm gold. Only warm tan-gold lines (about #C9A98A, highlights #E0C2A5) on navy (#0C1725): no other colours, no gradients, no grey, no paper texture. Reference 5 shows how the game draws its objects: draw in exactly that look. Using exactly that style, line weight and colours, draw a small square emblem for a page of a 1950s Palermo murder-mystery game's wiki (none of the people in the references):" + the object + " The object is centred in a square frame, large and clear, filling about two thirds of it, with calm empty navy space around it and nothing else in the picture; only a faint short line of shadow beneath it. Draw it with the same level of detail as the references: fine vertical hatching and clean contours. No faces, no people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no frame, no border."
